1329-3363-4779.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3363-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing The One Ring, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

2023-4460-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-4556--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-4556--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

772-4247-6553.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

4247-5058-7422.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6797-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6797-7818.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3525-3590-3755.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding {U}.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

2557-4365-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
2557-4365-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Clever Conjurer or Forensic Researcher

2872-5475-7786.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
If Clever Conjurer has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
If Forensic Researcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

360-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-3197-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

643-3212-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Kefnet.
When God-Eternal Kefnet dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Kefnet's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Kefnet.
As God-Eternal Kefnet is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Kefnet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

944-1824-2530-7351.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
944-1824-2530-7351.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
944-1824-2530-7351.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Prism Ring triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

3490-4289-4460-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-4460-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2308-4871-5231-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2308-4871-5231-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4871-5231-6458.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Thunder of Unity triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life
Repeat from step 2.

1734-4050-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1734-4050-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

4365-4682-5140-5184.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4365-4682-5140-5184.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Xorn and Mondrak.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4365-4682-5140-5184.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-851-1358-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2459-5147-5220-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

141-5256-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5256-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

1495-4120-6861.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
1495-4120-6861.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Quasiduplicate twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Quasiduplicate spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

934-4094-4508-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3490-5231-6701-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-5231-6701-6798.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

2104-2239-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Ardent Elementalist each turn.
2104-2239-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Ardent Elementalist from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1754-2921-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
1754-2921-4766-5683.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Guan Yu.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2292-4812-5145.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

3199-3209-4258.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
3199-3209-4258.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

147-1379-3210-5256.description:
Cast Scrap Mastery by paying {3}{R}{R}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Scrap Mastery.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing any player to mill two cards.
Resolve a copy of Scrap Mastery, swapping all nonland permanents you control with all nonland permanents in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

1617-3693.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters.
You have a way to give Bellowing Aegisaur indestructible.
1617-3693.description:
Give Bellowing Aegisaur indestructible by any method.
Activate Walking Ballisata by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Bellowing Aegisaur.
Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1591-3903.description:
Because of Teferi, opponent can only cast spells whenever they could cast a sorcery.
Whenever they cast a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
The opponent cannot cast the spell as permitted by Knowledge Pool due to Teferi.
